line_verbatim: Bandicoots (Chaeropus, Echymipera, Isoodon, Microperoryctes, Perameles, Peroryctes, Rhynchomeles) are 200-2300 g, terrestrial, nocturnal omnivores from Australia, Indonesia, and New Guinea.
